title: Update Our Legacy text and remove Enquiries section

requirements.summary: Replace all body text in the OurLegacy page with new content while preserving layout and scroll animations
acceptanceCriteria: The OurLegacy page displays all six paragraphs of the new text verbatim
The Trade Trust Score™ trademark symbol is preserved
Existing scroll-triggered animations and layout structure remain intact
No old legacy text content remains visible on the page

file_operations.description: Replace the entire body text content in the OurLegacy page component with the six new paragraphs provided in the BuildRequest. Preserve the existing page structure, scroll-triggered animation hooks (useScrollAnimation), heading hierarchy, and section layout. Ensure the Trade Trust Score™ trademark symbol is correctly rendered. Remove all old legacy text content.

requirements.summary: Remove the Enquiries page, route, and all navigation links to it while preserving the InquiryModal functionality
acceptanceCriteria: No 'Enquiries' page or route is accessible in the application
No navigation link to the Enquiries page appears in the Navigation bar or Footer
The rest of the application (Home, Annual Program, Our Legacy pages) renders without errors
The InquiryModal and consultation enquiry buttons continue to function normally

file_operations.description: Remove the ExportInquiries route and its import from the router configuration. Ensure the Home, AnnualProgram, and OurLegacy routes remain functional. The Layout component with Navigation, Footer, and InquiryModal should continue to work correctly.
Delete the ExportInquiries page component file as it is no longer needed after removing the Enquiries route.
Remove any navigation link or menu item pointing to the Enquiries/ExportInquiries page. Preserve all other navigation links and the mobile menu inquiry modal trigger.
Remove any link to the Enquiries page from the footer services list. Preserve all other footer content including the smooth-scroll section links and contact information.
